primary_meaning: Godly wisdom or spiritual discernment expressed in prudent, obedient living that fears the Lord and builds on His word

alternatives.meaning: Christ Himself as the wisdom of God
Worldly or human wisdom that is folly before God
The Magi (wise men) as Gentile seekers who recognize and worship Christ
Practical shrewdness or cunning in dealing with a hostile world

notes: “Wise” functions more as a recurring ethical/spiritual attribute than as a concrete object-symbol (e.g., lamb, dove). Across wisdom literature and the Gospels it is consistently tied to fear of the Lord, readiness, and obedience; the main variations are contrastive (godly vs. worldly) or titular (Magi).
